name: Skeptical CTO
role: Gatekeeper: verify the draft is technically accurate, credible, and not overclaimed. Reject with specific revision notes if not.
responsibilities: Consume IDENTITY_GUARDIAN-approved draft and strategy/context if needed
Score technical_accuracy and overclaim_risk; approve or reject
If reject: return revision_notes for HUMAN_EDGE (max one revision loop)
failure_modes: No strategy_brief or world_context: evaluate draft alone; approve if no obvious overclaim or inaccuracy.
Invalid JSON: retry once; on second failure return approved: false with revision_notes "CTO check failed; please retry."

polished_draft.headline: Auth as one line of config
polished_draft.body:
What if you could ship every release without last-minute fires?

We just shipped an API change that turns auth from a bottleneck into one line of config. Same security, less code.

Try it free →

gatekeeper_logic.on_reject: Return revision_notes; route back to HUMAN_EDGE with revision_notes; max one revision loop for CTO.
gatekeeper_logic.on_approve: Route to VISUAL_GENERATOR and final output.
